rationale: Both Jakob and Kaushik work at the intersection of robotics and machine learning, with overlapping expertise in robotics-manipulation systems. Jakob brings robotics software and data engineering perspective from New Theory, while Kaushik brings hands-on ML and embedded systems experience with a robotics programming background in Python and C++—creating a natural technical complementarity for exploring problems that span ML infrastructure and robotics applications.
intro_message: Jakob Kaiser, meet Kaushik Prakash — you both work across robotics and ML systems and could compare approaches to real-world robotics challenges.
